'''Ronaldus Joannes Michael Maria "Ronald" Does''' (born 13 January 1955 in [[Haarlem]])<ref>[http://albumacademicum.uva.nl/id/id001539 Prof. dr. R.J.M.M. Does, 1955 -] at the UvA ''Album Academicum'' website.</ref> is a Dutch [[mathematician]], known for several contributions to [[statistics]] and [[Lean Six Sigma]]. His research interests include control charts, Lean Six Sigma, and the integration of industrial statistics in services and healthcare.

Since 1991 he has been holding a full-professorship in Industrial Statistics at the [[University of Amsterdam]], first at its [[Korteweg-de Vries Institute for Mathematics]],<ref>[http://www.science.uva.nl/math KdvI]</ref> and since April 2009 at the department of Operations Management. In 2007 he has been appointed as ''fellow'' of the [[American Society for Quality]] and in 2014 as fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref>[http://www.amstat.org/newsroom/pressreleases/2014_ASAFellows.pdf ASA Fellows]</ref> He is the managing director and founder of the Institute for Business and Industrial Statistics of the University of Amsterdam.<ref>[http://www.ibisuva.nl/ IBIS UvA]</ref> Since 2011 he has also been director of the ''Executive Programmes'' of the University of Amsterdam.<ref>[http://abs.uva.nl/programmes/executive-programmes/ep.html Executive Programmes at the University of Amsterdam]</ref>

==Books==
*"Lean Six Sigma Stap voor Stap" (2008, in Dutch)
*"Lean Six Sigma for Services and Healthcare" (2012)
